claim: Original code performs automatic target selection, melee/projectile damage and lethal actor removal for 400 world ticks in an explicit synthetic Knight/KingTower fixture.
scope: 400 original world ticks with loaded Knight/KingTower/KingProjectile/action/stats records, native IDs and native actor factories. Automatic mode makes no host call to the target setter. This is an isolated fixture, not complete battle parity.

independent_execution.result: Entire JSON reports match exactly in separate emulator processes, including all 400 selected tick records, import/entry counts and executable hashes.

limitations: Synthetic empty 5x5 arena and selected globals materialized from CSV; original arena initializer runs but full arena data is absent
Original default mode constructor, two synthetic player-level records and placeholder account IDs; full match context initialization absent
Only supplied Knight/KingTower/rarity/global-ID/tag assets loaded; optional references in the complete manifest may remain unresolved
KingTower starting-action pointer resolves and original enqueue path runs, but normal INACTIVE/activation semantics are unverified
Original context phase setter is called once explicitly; top-level match scheduler and timing contract not established
Bounded allocation/free without reclamation, standard libc primitive models, isolated uncontended mutex/gettid models; selected original shipped libc++ functions execute
Selected live actor fields, counts and entry traces only; no complete raw-state/event differential oracle
Dead Knight state is marked absent after native removal; residual freed allocation contents are not reported as live state
The harness explicitly writes the context frame index before each world call; original outer match scheduling is not exercised.
The separately recovered TrainingCamp map and native match-context constructor are not integrated into this frozen fixture.
Exploratory self-contained harness is retained locally by hash and has not yet joined the public command set.
